description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2024 World Championships, undefeated through the first day. In a field full of Pokémon ex and V, Iron Thorns ex in the Active Spot switches off the Abilities of every Pokémon with a Rule Box except Future Pokémon, while coin-flip cards like Crushing Hammer and Pokémon Catcher, and cards that discard the opponent's Energy or send their cards to the Lost Zone, keep the opponent off balance. The 2024 World Championships were held at the Hawai'i Convention Center in Honolulu from 16 to 18 August 2024, back in Hawaii for the first time since 2012.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2024 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
